name: battery-storage-system
description: Battery Charge Tracking and Maintenance Management System

scripts.dev: npm run prepare && npm run electron:build && concurrently -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,green "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run prepare && npm run vite:build && npm run electron:build
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.release: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish=never
